Capability_Name: Single-Instance Lock & Process Guard
Implementation_Analysis: Implemented in attendance-common using fs2 lock, but never called in attendance-api/src/main.rs.

Capability_Name: 1-Minute Attendance Restart Cooldown (~/.last_attendance)
Implementation_Analysis: Rust enforces 60s user cooldown and 5s device cooldown in RAM, but does not persist ~/.last_attendance across restarts.

Capability_Name: OS Admin Elevation & Autostart Registration
Implementation_Analysis: Desktop OS registry/autostart replaced by server daemon architecture.

Capability_Name: Filepath Validation & Extension Whitelist
Implementation_Analysis: No centralized filepath extension validator in Rust.

Capability_Name: Company Setup & Creation (7 Fields + Duplicate Check)
Implementation_Analysis: Backend POST /api/v1/companies/create works, but browser Company modal crashes due to DOM ID mismatch (#company-view-menu vs #company-main-menu).

Capability_Name: Company Selection & Activation with Password Verification
Implementation_Analysis: Backend has hardcoded 'admin123' backdoor (company_routes.rs:82), does not filter users/attendance by active company_uuid, and UI modal crashes on open.

Capability_Name: Company Information Editing (Password-Protected)
Implementation_Analysis: Backend PUT /api/v1/companies/:id exists, but UI #company-view-edit vs #company-edit-view DOM ID mismatch prevents opening the edit view in browser.

Capability_Name: Pretrained FaceNet-512 Biometric Model Authenticity
Implementation_Analysis: models/facenet512.onnx (1,049,690 bytes, sha256=a58a4fe8bb65b21c) is a synthetic random-weight 4-layer stub generated by generate_onnx_models.py with np.random.randn(seed=42), NOT real FaceNet512 weights.

Capability_Name: MTCNN 3-Stage Face Detection & Multi-Face Rejection
Implementation_Analysis: MTCNN models in ./models/ have random weights (generate_onnx_models.py), pipeline.rs does not reject multi-face frames, and falls back to a 60% center box when 0 faces are detected.

Capability_Name: 5-Point Eye Landmark Face Alignment & 160x160 Z-Score Normalization
Implementation_Analysis: Mathematical affine eye-center rotation, 160x160 CatmullRom resize, per-image z-score standardization, and L2 normalization match DeepFace math.

Capability_Name: 20-Pose Guided Camera Registration (4s Interval & Pose Validation)
Implementation_Analysis: UI workspace fails to open in browser (#hr-workspace-body vs #hr-workspace-content); runAuto20PoseCapture captures 20 frames in 2.4s (120ms delay vs 4s), performs zero pose validation, and accepts 20 identical frames.

Capability_Name: Duplicate Face Detection Across Enrolled Users
Implementation_Analysis: Duplicate check (< 0.40 cosine distance) is implemented in user_routes.rs, but relies on synthetic 1.05 MB ONNX embeddings.

Capability_Name: FAISS IndexFlatL2 Disk Persistence (~/db/face_encodings.index & user_mappings.txt)
Implementation_Analysis: Rust stores embeddings in SQLite face_profiles and users.face_encoding only; neither ~/db/face_encodings.index nor ~/db/user_mappings.txt is read or written.

Capability_Name: Tiered Face Matching & Distance Metric (L2 vs Cosine)
Implementation_Analysis: Python computes Euclidean L2 distance via FAISS IndexFlatL2 and requires >=40% frame ratio when >=8 frames exist; Rust uses Cosine Distance (1 - dot) and index.rs bypasses the 40% ratio check whenever best_dist <= 0.60.
Database_Compatibility: Seeded EMP001..EMP010 have identical constant vectors [0.044194; 512]

Capability_Name: Identity Verification Split-Window & 5-Second Auto-Confirm Countdown
Implementation_Analysis: kiosk_view.rs defines #verify-confidence, #verify-min-dist, #verify-user-display, #verify-countdown-label, whereas scripts.rs queries #verify-confidence-text, #verify-distance-text, #verify-recognized-name, #verify-countdown-text — throwing TypeError before the 5s timer starts.

Capability_Name: Camera Attendance Punch & 3-Second Video Recording (.avi + S3 Upload)
Implementation_Analysis: Rust saves a single JPEG frame to data/captures/ instead of recording a 3-second 20fps XVID .avi video clip and uploading to AWS S3.
Frontend_Invokes_Backend: Broken in UI (Blocked by Split Modal crash)
Database_Compatibility: Saves local JPEG path in video_path_in/out

Capability_Name: User Registration Without Camera (512-Zero Embedding Vector)
Implementation_Analysis: Backend stores [0.0; 512] in users.face_encoding, but browser HR workspace is unreachable due to #hr-workspace-body vs #hr-workspace-content DOM mismatch.

Capability_Name: In & Out Without Camera (Username + Password Login/Logout)
Implementation_Analysis: Works end-to-end in UI and API, but auto-toggles IN_TIME/OUT_TIME instead of offering separate Login/Logout buttons and lacks 3s background webcam capture.

Capability_Name: Interactive Forgot Password Verification & Reset Window
Implementation_Analysis: Python opens an interactive password reset dialog; Rust only pops up a static JavaScript alert() telling the user to contact HR.

Capability_Name: User Registration With QR Code & Duplicate Device Check
Implementation_Analysis: Backend /api/v1/users/check-device/:android_id and registration work, but UI HR workspace is blocked by DOM mismatch and lacks live QR generation inside the registration form.

Capability_Name: In & Out With QR Code (AndroidIDReceiver HTTP + Ngrok Tunnel)
Implementation_Analysis: Backend /receive_android_id & /api/v1/devices/session exist, but modal-qr has #qr-login-box/#qr-session-status while scripts.rs targets #qr-svg-container/#qr-session-url-text, and polling checks status==='COMPLETED' instead of received===true.
Database_Compatibility: Manual Android ID punch works via API

Capability_Name: 9 Kiosk Attendance Display Cards & Monthly Late/Early Stats
Implementation_Analysis: All 9 card IDs match between kiosk_view.rs and scripts.rs, and /api/v1/attendance/user-stats/:username returns monthly counts, though late/early thresholds are simplified.

Capability_Name: Last 7 Days Attendance History Popup Table
Implementation_Analysis: Backend returns {history: [...], success: true}, but scripts.rs:885 loops over data.length instead of data.history.length, resulting in an empty table.

Capability_Name: HR Portal Authentication & Auto-Initialized Default Password
Implementation_Analysis: kiosk_view.rs uses #hr-auth-login-view and #hr-auth-change-view while scripts.rs queries #hr-login-view and #hr-change-pw-view, crashing openHrManagement() with TypeError before modal-hr-auth can open.

Capability_Name: Change HR Password Workflow
Implementation_Analysis: Backend endpoint works, but toggleHrChangePasswordView() crashes in browser due to #hr-auth-change-view vs #hr-change-pw-view DOM ID mismatch.

Capability_Name: Sync HR Password from Cloud (PostgreSQL -> Local SQLite)
Implementation_Analysis: Route /api/v1/auth/sync-hr-password is wired to handle_set_hr_password with default 'HR@123', which overwrites the local HR password instead of pulling from cloud.

Capability_Name: HR Action: Sync User Data to Local (Cloud -> Local SQLite & FAISS)
Implementation_Analysis: Does not connect to any cloud DB; merely reads local SQLite users and re-inserts their embeddings into in-memory FaceIndex.

Capability_Name: HR Action: Sync Local User to Cloud (Local SQLite -> Cloud DB)
Implementation_Analysis: Queues events into bigquery_outbox, which BigQueryClient::stream_batch marks as synced without making any network call.

Capability_Name: HR Action: Customized Attendance Report (CSV & Excel Export)
Implementation_Analysis: scripts.rs calls /api/v1/reports/customized.csv?from_date=... (HTTP 404; backend route is /api/v1/reports/customized-csv requiring integer year, month, from_day, to_day) and /api/v1/reports/muster-roll?month=2026-10 (HTTP 400; requires integer year & month). Also lacks multi-sheet .xlsx export.
Database_Compatibility: Compatible when called with integer params

Capability_Name: HR Action: Verify Attendance Images / Check Fake Attendance
Implementation_Analysis: Backend /api/v1/reports/verify-images returns local image paths, but lacks S3 video download/playback, lacks date/user filter UI, and is blocked in browser by HR workspace DOM mismatch.

Capability_Name: HR Action: Upload AI Model (.onnx / .h5)
Implementation_Analysis: Writes uploaded base64 bytes to models/<name>, but does not validate ONNX graph structure or reload state.deepface_state in memory without server restart; blocked in browser by HR workspace DOM mismatch.

Capability_Name: HR Action: Delete Face Data (Single User & Full Reset)
Implementation_Analysis: DELETE /api/v1/face/profiles/:username deletes from SQLite face_profiles but does NOT remove the user from in-memory state.face_index or clear users.face_encoding! Full reset (/api/v1/face/reset) clears both.
Database_Compatibility: Partial (leaves stale embedding in RAM & users table)

Capability_Name: HR Action: Embeddings Report (12-Column Statistical Analysis CSV/View)
Implementation_Analysis: Backend generates all 12 exact Python columns (Username, Image_Name, Number_of_Embeddings_Generated, Nan/Zero/Neg/Pos, Top 5 Low/Mid/High) in JSON and CSV, but UI view is blocked by HR workspace DOM mismatch.

Capability_Name: User Management Portal (Edit/Delete Users, View Enrollments)
Implementation_Analysis: REST API supports GET/POST/DELETE users, but the dedicated interactive User Management table/editor window from attendance_v8.py is not in kiosk_view.rs.

Capability_Name: Attendance Timestamp Storage Format (UTC vs Local Asia/Dhaka)
Implementation_Analysis: Python stores full UTC timestamps in in_time/out_time and converts to Asia/Dhaka on read; Rust stores local Asia/Dhaka time-only 'HH:MM:SS', causing 6-hour skew and ValueError in Python.

Capability_Name: Attendance Record Primary Key Format (<user_uuid>_<DD_Mon_YYYY>)
Implementation_Analysis: Rust formats record_id as <user_uuid>_<DD_Mon_YYYY> for new records, but stores date column as 'YYYY-MM-DD' instead of 'DD_Mon_YYYY'.

Capability_Name: SQLite Database Path & Schema Compatibility (~/db/company_info.db vs data/attendance.db)
Implementation_Analysis: Rust uses data/attendance.db instead of ~/db/company_info.db, adds 16 extra ERP tables + face_profiles, and omits original Python data migration from ~/db/company_info.db.

Capability_Name: Password Storage & Verification Security
Implementation_Analysis: Rust supports SHA-1 and plaintext fallback, but introduces hardcoded universal backdoors ('HR@123', '1234', 'admin123', 'hr2026') in hr_auth.rs and company_routes.rs.

Capability_Name: System Console Terminal Log Viewer, Export & Clear
Implementation_Analysis: Clear and Export buttons work in browser; Force Sync button (🔄) calls POST /api/v1/sync/process which returns 404 Not Found (backend route is /api/v1/sync/trigger).

Capability_Name: Header Active Company Badge Display
Implementation_Analysis: kiosk_view.rs:26 defines id='header-company-name', whereas scripts.rs:122 queries getElementById('header-company-badge') (null), so the header badge never updates when switching companies.

Capability_Name: Background Network Monitor & Auto-Sync Thread
Implementation_Analysis: Outbox worker runs every 15s in Tokio background task, but drains to the no-op BigQueryClient stub.

Capability_Name: Historical Enrolled Biometric Profiles Compatibility
Implementation_Analysis: Seeded users EMP001..EMP010 all share the exact same constant vector [0.044194; 512] in face_profiles, and C_DEV001..C_OPS004 have synthetic arithmetic ramp vectors.
